messages:
sam: heads-up: seeing gradual memory errors on rtx-a100-3.gpu42 in usw1-pool3. ECC count is ticking up, Xid 13 about every ~2h. Remap/page-retire count also climbing. tagging infra-oncall :eyes:
oncall-bot: ALERT: gpu_faults: host=rtx-node-34 gpu=42 metric=ecc_uncorrected rate=0.02/s
maria: which host exactly? is this new since last reboot or resurfacing?
sam: New trend over past 72h. Host: rtx-node-34 (10.10.34.12). NVSM logs show page retirement entries and repeated Xid 13. Quick collectors: `sudo /opt/gpu-tools/collect-gpu-metrics --gpu 42`
jin: can someone paste `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY` and `dmesg | grep -i "remap\|Xid"`? suspect row remap / page retirement growing, want to see remap_count and HBM errors.
sam: output (trimmed):
```
# nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY (gpu 42)
FB Memory Usage
  Total                     : 51200 MiB
  Used                      : 48200 MiB
  Error Corrected (ECC)     : 12
  Error Uncorrected (ECC)   : 4
Page Retirements:
  Remap Count               : 5 -> 9 (72h)
  Last Remap                : 2026-03-16T21:14:03Z
# dmesg | grep -i remap
[ 12345.678901] nvidia0: page retirement: remap entry added idx=3 offset=0x1f400000
[ 23456.789012] nvidia0: Xid 13: PERSISTENT FAULT at Xid 13
```
leo: if remap_count >= 8, our standard is to drain and replace. do we have spare capacity in usw1-pool3?
maria: usw1-pool3 is at ~80% used right now, but we have 2 warm spares in usw1. i'll schedule drain; tagging @ops for cordon/drain.
ops-bot: Job 8732 created: cordon rtx-node-34; drain plan: migrate containers, reassign shards, trigger live-migration where supported. ETA ~20m.
jin: also check HBM remap table directly: `sudo cat /sys/kernel/debug/nvidia0/hub_remap` — look for growing entries and repeated offsets. attach to ticket.
sam: adding logs and outputs to INFRA-6421. noteworthy: remap growth seems correlated with heavy long-running kernels from a small set of tenants (32k-seq training and long context evals). could be hot-spotting a particular HBM row.
maria: i'll evict the heavy-memory tenants from pool and run extended memtest86 after drain completes. if page_retire increases after memtest, initiate replacement under warranty. :thumbsup: 
oncall-bot: Update: drain started 1779991400, migration progress 5/6 tasks completed.
leo: after drain+memtest, let's mark this GPU as isolated (no-schedule) and set pool routing policy to prefer quantized/low-memory models for the remaining nodes until replacement.
sam: thanks all — i'll update INFRA-6421 with final memtest results and replacement decision.
